I1.quote: Searched for a measured H2 uptake (absorbed amount) by gravimetric, volumetric or flow method; found only Sieverts-measured hydrogen desorbed on heating to 350 C under vacuum (Eq. 2; Fig. 5); rehydrogenation at 80 bar reports no absorbed amount.

I2.quote: Not assessed because I1 is not met.

I4.quote: Not assessed because I1 is not met.

I5.quote: New host material of activated carbon nanofiber (ACNF) prepared from carbonization and KOH activation of polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based fibers is proposed for nanocofinement of LiBH4.

notes: Paper is a complex-hydride study: LiBH4 nanoconfined in an activated carbon nanofiber scaffold; the hydrogen is released by chemical decomposition of LiBH4 and re-formed by a rehydrogenation reaction. Every reported hydrogen quantity is a desorbed amount measured volumetrically during a temperature ramp to 350 C under vacuum: 'Once the pressure reading was constant over a period of time, the amount of hydrogen released was calculated by the pressure change' and 'H2 desorbed (wt.%) = [(n x 2.0158)/sample weight] x 100' (main, p. 3, Experimental details, Eqs. 1-2); Fig. 5 (main, p. 6) plots 'H2 desorbed (wt. %)' vs time; text gives '3.3 wt.% H2' (1st) and '2.88 and 2.77 wt.% H2' (2nd, 3rd cycles) released (main, p. 7). The 0-3000 psig transducer is said to measure 'pressure changes due to hydrogen desorption and absorption' (main, p. 3), but no absorbed amount is reported; the 'reproduces' capacity (10.1 wt.% vs LiBH4) is inferred from the next desorption. I read this as thermal desorption without an uptake value plus a hydrogenation reaction without a measured uptake (both listed I1 exclusions), so I1 fails and the code is no_conditions_stated. For the resolver: if desorption after gas-phase rehydrogenation were accepted as an uptake measurement, I2 would fail instead (code not_carbon): the only sorbents measured are bulk LiBH4 (a hydride) and nano LiBH4-ACNF, which 'contained 52.38 wt.% of LiBH4' (main, p. 6), so carbon is not the majority component by mass; the bare ACNF's H2 uptake was not measured. For completeness, I4 would be met: Table 1 (main, p. 3) gives SBET 994.5 m2/g for ACNF and 1.2 m2/g for nano LiBH4-ACNF. Not a review/thesis/patent; record and PDF show no retraction; no statement that the data were published before. Abstract quote restores the hyphen in '(PAN)-based' that the text layer dropped; 'nanocofinement' is the original spelling.
